maria.h (sec): Hey — quick question on the audit log CSV export we surface for SOC teams. Is the current export using comma delimiters or TSV? Need to know for our parsing script.

sam.devops: It's comma by default right now. We can switch to TSV if people expect tabs. Why do you ask?

maria.h (sec): Commas break on message text that contains commas (user agent strings, resource names). SOC wants stable CSV w/ quoting, but many of our downstream tools assume tabs. Also need clarity on which fields are included in the ad-hoc export (actor_id, ip_address, resource, event_type, raw_payload).

jordan.research: For privacy we should redact IPs unless the requester has approval. Our policy requires an access approval for PII exports. Is this one gated?

sam.devops: Good call. Right now ad-hoc exports are gated by role-based perms (team:security, role:auditor). But the export endpoint doesn't automatically redact fields. We can add a redact flag.

maria.h (sec): Can you confirm approval flow? SOC asks: who can run "export events" and what's retention on exported files?

lizzy.prodops: @sam.devops — we should require an explicit ticket in the compliance tracker for any export containing ip_address or raw_payload. Retention: exported files live in the temp bucket for 7 days by default, then lifecycle deletes. We can shorten to 3 days for high-sensitivity exports.

sam.devops: Agreed. Proposed change: default delimiter -> TSV; export endpoint to accept ?redact=ips,?redact=payload; require header X-Approval-ID for PII exports. Also log who triggered export as a separate immutable audit entry.

maria.h (sec): That sounds good. Can you mock the CSV header we would produce so I can show SOC?

sam.devops: Sure — example (TSV):

```
actor_id\tactor_display_name\tevent_type\tresource\ttimestamp\tip_address\traw_payload\n1234\tAlice Smith\tMODEL_DEPLOY\tmodel/redwood-v1\t2026-02-03T14:22:11Z\t10.2.3.4\t{...}
```

jordan.research: For exports where redact=ips we would emit ip_address as "REDACTED" and put a separate generated_id that maps to a short-lived lookup. That should preserve utility for flow analysis but avoid sharing PII.

maria.h (sec): Perfect. Also can we add actor_display_name — SOC finds numeric IDs hard to consume.

sam.devops: Will add actor_display_name to the schema and bump the export API version to v2. We should also publish a small changelog in docs.

audit-bot: Scheduled runbook note: /runbooks/audit-exports now documents approval -> bucket retention -> redaction flags. Link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/audit-exports

lizzy.prodops: I'll file a compliance tracker ticket for the SOC team and set required retention to 3 days for PII exports. tagging: @maria.h (sec) to approve.

maria.h (sec): SGTM. I'll approve the ticket once you create it. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
